content:
evie_peopleops: quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A 11 dropping two less-common scenarios managers asked about so you don't have to DM us: 1) promotions during a secondment (temporary assignment to another team/org), and 2) promos tied to contractor->FTE conversions. short answers up top, details & scripts below.
tony_totalrewards: TL;DR: secondments can be promoted in-flight if evidence lines up and both home and host managers agree; contractor conversions follow the conversion policy and comp anchors depend on hire paperwork effective date.

evie_peopleops: 1) secondment (temporary assignment) promotions
- principle: we treat the employee's primary employment record as the canonical source. promotion requests should include sign-off from both the home manager and the host/assignment manager.
- effective date: set to the agreed promotion effective date (can be during the secondment). include the host manager's endorsement in the packet to show demonstrated scope.
- payroll: retro rules same as normal (retro to effective date if approvals hit payroll cutoff). note: if host manager pays any stipend/bonus during secondment, document how that interacts with comp changes.
- manager script: "Congrats <name> 1 you're being promoted to <new title> effective <date>. This reflects impact while on your assignment with <team>. People Ops will follow with paperwork; both managers are looped in for clarity."

alex_eng_mgr: helpful. what about internal mobility where someone moves teams and we want to promote at the same time?
evie_peopleops: treat as combined change: packet should show both role change details and promotion rationale; sign-off from new manager is required. note the hire-date anchor for any new bonus or leveling questions.

zoe_engineer: 2) contractor -> FTE conversion + promotion at conversion time
tony_totalrewards: short rules:
- anchor for base comp: the FTE offer letter effective date anchors the new base. if the conversion includes a promotion, the effective date in the packet should match the conversion effective date to keep payroll clean.
- retro pay: if conversion + promotion is backdated, retro follows the effective date subject to payroll cutoff.
- equity: contractors do not receive RSUs before conversion. any grant tied to the promotion post-conversion follows normal grant approvals and will not be back-applied to contractor period.
- manager script: "Hi <name>, as part of your conversion to full time on <date> we're promoting you to <new title>. This reflects your work on <project>. We'll finalize offer/grant details via People Ops and payroll. Reach out with Qs."

nina_ceo: one tiny ask: add a note about urgent off-cycle corrections if payroll shows wrong pay after a conversion/promo.
evie_peopleops: good call. corrections note:
- if payroll posts an incorrect retro or misses retro entirely, escalate to people-ops@redwood.in with subject: "PAYROLL CORRECTION - <name>" and include the packet ID and screenshots. Payroll error corrections are prioritized and typically resolved within 2 business days.

people-ops-bot: Promo/Conversion packet template (secondment + contractor conversion samples) uploaded: https://drive.google.com/example-secondment-conversion (auto-note)

evie_peopleops: final logistics: i'll publish a slim one-pager in #managers with the two sample packets (anonymized), the scripts above, and the escalation subject lines. scheduling one 15-min office hour focused on conversions this Friday 9am PT. ping here to reserve a private review slot.
zoe_engineer: super useful 1 thanks.

evie_peopleops: thanks all 1 keep dropping edge cases here and we'll add them to the one-pager.
